summary: Tested new encrypted hot-wallet seed management (backend endpoints + Settings UI). All 8 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: admin login → Settings → Гарячий гаманець tab → Безпека сід-фрази card → invalid-mnemonic error toast → valid 12-word BIP-39 success toast + new EVM/TRON addresses displayed. DB verified to store only `mnemonic_enc` (Fernet 'gAAAA' token), no plaintext `mnemonic` field. Plaintext never leaks in any API response.

issues: After setting a user seed, the 'auto-generated' warning badge is correctly hidden; however the 'Зашифровано в БД ✓' badge keeps the same emerald tone — a subtle visual cue that the seed is now user-set (e.g. secondary badge 'Користувацька сід-фраза') would improve clarity. Minor cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2419 lines — recommend splitting hot-wallet, admin, auth routers into separate modules (maintainability).

hot_wallet_set_mnemonic resets in-memory _seed to None and calls ensure_seed() — thread-safe for current single-worker but if backend ever runs multiple workers this becomes racy; consider a per-worker reload signal.
seed-status endpoint returns env_override flag — good; consider logging an audit event each time set-mnemonic is called (currently a single logger.warning line) with admin user id.
seed_data_creation: During testing the hot-wallet seed was replaced with a freshly generated 12-word BIP-39 mnemonic (test only — not a production seed). Current DB state: system/_id=wallet has mnemonic_enc set, auto_generated=false. Resulting hot-wallet EVM 0x4202baB36C02e4DcACCFFf22f6CBA8b5C8319c90 / TRON TXSrrLkpAmD1Be3CdojpZraYb9mGFxxqwk. No real funds involved. If main agent wants to revert to auto-generated, delete the `mnemonic_enc`+`auto_generated` fields from system/_id=wallet and restart backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses response envelope {status:true, data:{...}} for admin hot-wallet endpoints — unwrap `data` before asserting. Seed is now user-set (not auto). To re-test auto-generation path, clear system/_id=wallet document. MNEMONIC_ENC_KEY is in /app/backend/.env; losing it will make existing encrypted seeds unrecoverable. WALLET_MNEMONIC env is intentionally NOT set.
verified_features: GET /api/admin/hot-wallet/seed-status: 401 unauth; 200 admin with all 7 expected keys; evm_address starts 0x, 42 chars; tron starts T; encrypted_at_rest=true

POST /api/admin/hot-wallet/set-mnemonic: 401 unauth; 400 on invalid BIP-39 with Ukrainian error 'Некоректна сід-фраза'; 200 on valid 12-word mnemonic returning new evm_address+tron_address; plaintext mnemonic absent from response body
DB: system/_id=wallet contains mnemonic_enc starting 'gAAAA' (Fernet), no plaintext 'mnemonic' key, auto_generated=false after set

UI: tab-hotwallet visible for admin; seed-security-card visible with 'Зашифровано в БД' badge; seed-set-open reveals seed-input + seed-save-btn; invalid phrase shows error toast; valid phrase shows success toast 'Сід збережено у зашифрованому вигляді' and updates on-page EVM/TRON addresses
